independent_replay_script:
from pathlib import Path
import struct,re,json,hashlib
d=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
base=d.parent
obs=base/'observer-final'
elf=base/'target-priority-resume/aarch64-unknown-none/release/jnox-kernel'
b=(d/'audit.bin').read_bytes()
n,f,q=struct.unpack_from('<3Q',b)
assert n==21 and q==f//10 and len(b)==24+32*144
trace=(d/'int.trace').read_text()
actual=re.findall(r'Exception return .*? PC (0x\w+)|Taking exception \d+ \[(IRQ|SVC)\].*?with ESR 0x\w+/(0x\w+).*?with ELR (0x\w+)',trace,re.S)
dis=(d/'disassembly.txt').read_text()
sym=(d/'symbols.txt').read_text()
assert re.search('40203650 0000000000024000 b .*STACKS',sym)
assert re.search(r'add\s+sp, sp, #0x340',dis)
assert json.loads((d/'launch.json').read_text())['audit_address']==0x40227658 and re.search('40227658 .*priority_resume_witness',sym)
observed=[]
details=[]
entry=[0x402012bc,0x4020128c,0x4020124c]
for ep,events in enumerate([[0,1,2,4,3,4,4],[0,1,2,3,4,4,4],[0,1,2,4,5,4,4]]):
    ready=[]; runner=3; grant=None; suspended={}; progress=[0]*3; budgets=[q if ep==2 else 0]*3
    for j,event in enumerate(events):
        row=struct.unpack_from('<18Q',b,24+144*(ep*7+j))
        epoch,ev,src,dst,packed,begin,end,due,before,after,start,deadline,avail,pc,ret,frame,rest,x=row
        assert (epoch,ev,src)==(ep,event,runner)
        top=lambda t:0x40203650+(ep*3+t+1)*16384
        if ev:
            assert (begin,due,before)==grant and end>begin
            assert frame==top(src)-0x350 and x>progress[src]
            progress[src]=x
            if src in [0,1]: assert x==4097
            assert after==(max(0,before-(end-begin)) if ep==2 else 0)
            budgets[src]=q if ev==5 else after
            suspended[src]=(pc,frame)
            if ev in [1,2,5]:
                assert due<=end<=due+q//8 and pc in [0x4020126c,0x40201270,0x40201274]
                if ev==5: assert after==0
                observed.append(('IRQ',pc,None))
            else:
                imm=2 if ev==3 else 1
                assert re.search(r'%x:\s+\w+\s+svc\s+#0x%x\b'%(pc-4,imm),dis)
                assert pc==({0:0x402012e8,1:0x402012b8,2:0x40201288}[src] if imm==1 else 0x40201280)
                observed.append(('SVC',pc,imm))
        else:
            assert not any([begin,end,due,before,after,pc,frame,x])
        if ev==0: ready.append(2)
        if ev in [1,2]:
            ready.append(2-ev)
            if ev==2 and ep!=1: ready.insert(0,src); runner=3
        if ev in [3,5]: ready.append(src); runner=3
        if ev==4: runner=3
        if runner==3 and ready:
            runner=min(ready,key=lambda t: t!=0); ready.remove(runner)
        assert (dst,packed)==(runner,sum((t+1)<<(4*i) for i,t in enumerate(ready)))
        if dst==3: assert not any([start,deadline,avail,ret,rest])
        else:
            assert (ret,rest)==suspended.get(dst,(entry[dst],top(dst)-0x340))
            assert start>=end and avail==budgets[dst]
            assert deadline==(start+q//4 if j<2 else start+avail if ep==2 else 0)
            observed.append(('return',ret,None))
        grant=(start,deadline,avail)
        details.append(dict(row=row,queue=list(ready),service=end-begin,irq_late=end-due if ev in [1,2,5] else None))
expected=[('return',int(r,16),None) if r else (kind,int(pc,16),int(esr,16)&65535 if kind=='SVC' else None) for r,kind,esr,pc in actual]
assert expected==observed and len(expected)==36
assert (d/'uart.bin').read_bytes()==b'JNOX M1 BOOT\nJNOX M1 READY\nPRIORITY RESUME BEGIN\nPRIORITY RESUME PASS\n'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(elf)=='b1d003f72b8aa7b06461313fa6577411bed287e2d8c4ec866d7146b3aae0c337'
linux='/mnt/d/codex/.jnox-work/release-cases/'
report=dict(verdict='PASS',command=f'cd {linux}observer-final && PRIORITY_RESUME_CAPTURE_DIR={linux}priority-schema-raw python3 -B {linux}observer-final/tools/qemu_boot.py --profile priority-resume --qemu {linux}observer-final/tools/priority_resume_capture.py --kernel {linux}target-priority-resume/aarch64-unknown-none/release/jnox-kernel',launcher_stdout_argv_prefix=['/usr/bin/python3','-B',linux+'observer-final/tools/priority_resume_capture.py'],observer_revision='775ecb7426d57204091f3f1ffbecc2c0f8ec02c8',kernel_revision='93c64c853c3d1bf3f6286da59d83d7dc8394f7b9',sha256={str(p):sha(p) for p in [elf,obs/'tools/qemu_boot.py',obs/'tools/priority_resume_capture.py',obs/'docs/m1-priority-resume.en.md',*sorted(d.iterdir())] if p.is_file()},header=[n,f,q],events=expected,columns='epoch event from to queue begin end due budget_before budget_after next_begin next_due next_budget save_pc return_pc save_frame return_frame progress'.split(),rows=details,regressions='Separate profile owners; one priority-resume boot in this slot')
(base/'priority-schema.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
